label: V1 invalid-checksum revision
verification: The VANOS runtime behavior was proven on-car, but the released descriptor omitted the enforced MS41.0 program-checksum recomputation. Retained byte-for-byte for exact installed-image detection and safe removal.
title: VANOS minimum RPM
user_description: Deprecated MS41.0 V1 retained only to detect and remove installed VANOSRT1 images before installing V2. V1 omitted the required program-checksum update.
description: DEPRECATED and remove-only. V1 contains the on-car-proven VANOS minimum-RPM runtime logic, but its released descriptor changed program bytes without recomputing the enforced MS41.0 program checksum. Marker VANOSRT1 at file 0x17008 identifies this exact revision. The descriptor now requests program recomputation so removal is checksum-safe; install V2 instead.
